edge_case_summary: Wind tower base sections permissible on weather deck: bulker vs MPP comparison — verifies matcher correctly evaluates deck-stowage as an acceptable alternative for cargo with deck_stowage_permitted restriction.

cargo_inquiries.hold_geometry_required: sections 16m × 5m diameter, 40t each, 12 sections total; deck stowage permissible for up to 8 sections
restrictions: Deck stowage permissible for up to 8 of 12 sections
Remaining sections must be below deck with ≥17m hatch clear length
Vessel must have deck reinforcement ≥8t/m² for tower sections

vessel_positions.hatch_dimensions: Hold 1: 38m × 14m clear length; Hold 2: 30m × 14m clear length. Open deck 80m × 14m reinforced 10t/m².
5 hatches, 14m × 12m each. Standard bulker weather deck, no special reinforcement listed.

readiness.explanation: M/V Jutland Express opens Esbjerg 02-Jun — at load port. 4 days before laycan start 06-Jun. Crane 2×100t satisfies 80t lift. Hold 1 (38m) and Hold 2 (30m) accommodate 16m sections. Deck 80m reinforced 10t/m² > required 8t/m². Previous wind tower cargo experience. Ideal.

M/V North Sea Trader opens Copenhagen 31-May. Copenhagen to Esbjerg ~230nm at 13.0kn = ~18h, arrives ~01-Jun — 5 days before laycan start 06-Jun. CRANE_VIOLATION: crane 4×30t, max single hook 30t < required 80t. HOLD_GEOMETRY_VIOLATION: max hatch length 14m < required 17m for below-deck sections. Deck reinforcement unspecified — standard bulker deck likely insufficient for 8t/m².
date_issues: CRANE_VIOLATION: 4×30t max single hook 30t < required 80t. HOLD_GEOMETRY_VIOLATION: 14m hatch < 17m required. Deck reinforcement status unknown.

readiness.explanation: M/V Flensburg Carrier opens Hamburg 03-Jun. Hamburg to Esbjerg ~330nm at 14.0kn = ~24h, arrives ~04-Jun — 2 days before laycan start 06-Jun. Crane 2×80t meets lift requirement exactly. Hold 1 (32m) and Hold 2 (25m) both > 17m minimum. Deck reinforced 9t/m² > required 8t/m². Tight timing.
date_issues: Arrival 04-Jun — 2 days before laycan start. Limited buffer.
